mechanism: Tranylcypromine (MAOI) inhibits monoamine oxidase, preventing nicotine metabolism and increasing sympathomimetic effects; nicotine's noradrenergic activity combined with MAOI inhibition increases risk of hypertensive crisis and cardiovascular events.
action: Avoid concurrent use or monitor blood pressure closely with frequent reassessment; counsel patient on hypertensive crisis warning signs and consider alternative smoking cessation methods with MAOIs.
